prompts.name: 01-discover.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a polished, realistic desktop web-app interface concept for PixelQuest, a game discovery catalogue. Wide landscape 16:10 image. Edge-to-edge flat screenshot with no browser chrome, no device mockup, no perspective, no watermark. Consistent design system: near-black navy #0d1020 background, violet #8b5cf6 accent, pale text, subdued borders, 12px card radii, elegant sans-serif typography, spacious but practical dashboard. Fixed 200px left sidebar with PixelQuest wordmark and a simple pixel diamond symbol, nav Discover, Genres, Favorites. Slim top search field and profile circle. Use original fictional game artwork and fictional titles only, no existing videogame branding. Sharp readable UI labels, professional portfolio quality. Screen: Discover. Heading 'Discover your next adventure'. A large cinematic featured banner for fictional game 'Astral Frontier' with a luminous violet alien planet and astronaut silhouette, CTA 'Explore game'. Below, heading 'Trending this week', four equal game cards with original artwork for 'Neon Circuit' (neon racing), 'Verdant Kingdom' (fantasy forest), 'Echoes of Mars' (red desert sci-fi), 'Pixel Odyssey' (pixel landscape). Show restrained genre chips, ratings, and outline favorite hearts. Discover active in sidebar. All artwork contained within banner and cards.
